notes.title: Playtest Version Released！
notes.notes: [p]Dear Rhythm Hotel Travelers[/p][p]Our hotel is still under construction. To collect your valuable feedback and further refine the game, we’ve opened 3 levels in the Playtest version! Simply request, and you’ll receive playtest access.[/p][olist][*][p]Philosophy on Donkey-kicking[/p][/*][*][p]New Oath of the Peach Garden[/p][/*][*][p]Scientific Snapshots[/p][/*][/olist][p]Before our game release, we’ll regularly review your feedback and incorporate it into future updates. Maintenance and upgrades will occur periodically.[/p][p]Our team is working tirelessly to accelerate progress and open Rhythm Hostel’s doors to travelers worldwide as soon as possible![/p][p]Your input is essential! Keep sharing your experiences and ideas through our [url="https://discord.com/invite/ENet75YjE7"]Discord community[/url].[/p]

notes.title: [Rhythm Hotel] Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[p]"Rhythm Hotel" will soon launch its Playtest![/p][p]Want to download and try the game early? Join our Discord and contact us to receive a demo key!
Demo keys will be distributed starting [b]June 12th[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Join us now, we need your feedback and suggestions.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/ENet75YjE7"]https://discord.gg/ENet75YjE7[/url][/p]
